subject: Planning: LumenHealth customer story mini-series + call sheet
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Planning: LumenHealth customer story mini-series + call sheet

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a short customer video series with us. To help operations and legal move quickly, I put together a short plan and a couple of asks below. Goal is a 3-episode mini-series (each 90–120s) that highlights: (1) the problem LumenHealth solved, (2) workflow + outcomes, and (3) forward-looking product partnership.

High-level asks from your side:
- Confirm whether Lumen prefers on-site filming at your HQ or an off-site studio.
- Confirm primary spokespeople for each episode (names + job titles).
- Confirm any internal approvals or legal signoffs and timing for the release form.
- Share any brand/video guidelines and logo assets.

Logistics we can handle from Redwood:
- Call sheet and run-of-show (attached call_sheet_template.xlsx).
- Release form for signature (attached redwood_release_form_v1.pdf).
- Production vendor options (we can use BrightFrame or your vendors).

Proposed windows for filming: week of Dec 7–9 (flexible). If that works, we can lock dates and I’ll circulate a draft itinerary + shot list.

Would you prefer a quick 20–30 minute planning call this week to align on spokespeople and dates?

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0137

Attachments: redwood_release_form_v1.pdf (pdf), call_sheet_template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@lumenhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Ross <michael.ross@lumenhealth.com>, video@lumenhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Planning: LumenHealth customer story mini-series + call sheet

Hi Neha —

Love the outline, thanks. We’re happy to move forward with a 3-episode mini-series. A few quick notes from Legal/Comms: 
- Lumen requires a signed release from each on-camera participant; legal prefers PDF signatures via DocuSign or Adobe Sign.
- We’ll need to include our brand guidelines and logo package (see attached) and route an internal approval with Comms (Michael is copied).

Regarding logistics: we prefer on-site at our HQ for authenticity. Primary spokespeople: 
- Episode 1 (Problem): Dr. Priya Malhotra, Chief Medical Officer
- Episode 2 (Workflow): Samir Gupta, Director of Ops
- Episode 3 (Outcomes): Maria Lopez, VP, Clinical Services

Available dates: Dec 8–9 are best for the spokespeople above; Dec 7 is a hard no. If you can do Dec 8–9, we’ll block calendars.

Also: Comms would like a brief run-of-show and a 6–8 shot B-roll list before the shoot so they can prep the facilities team.

If you want to quick sync tomorrow 10–10:30am PT, I can join.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Head of Partnerships
LumenHealth
aisha.patel@lumenhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0922

Attachments: lumen_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf)

Team —

Looping you both in to start production prep. Aisha confirmed spokespeople and wants on-site filming Dec 8–9. Action items:
- Marissa: can you draft a 12–15 question interview guide for the three episodes? Focus on concise, anecdotal prompts (we want natural soundbites). Please include 2–3 optional product-specific questions per episode for Samir / Maria.
- Ben: can you check vendor availability and get a high-level estimate for on-site crew + 2-camera setup, sound, and an assistant? Also confirm whether we should use BrightFrame (copy below) or a different vendor. Please flag any budget concerns.

I’ve attached a brief proposed itinerary to start (proposed_itinerary.docx). If BrightFrame isn’t available we’ll ask Aisha for their preferred vendor.

I’ll coordinate logistics with Aisha and get the DocuSign release routed once legal confirms language. Marissa — if you can have a first draft by EOD Tuesday that would be ideal.

Thanks —
Neha
